capabilities: Load combatant notes from a folder or by search
Sort combatants by initiative and advance turns and rounds
Apply damage, healing and toggle conditions on combatant cards
Record combat events in a new or existing Markdown note
Track extra numeric fields like MP or stamina with quick buttons
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author wanted a simple, lightweight way to track initiative and health in RPG sessions without heavy systems or cluttered panels.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run tabletop RPG combat, tracking initiative order, health and conditions during game sessions.
summary: Battle tracker for tabletop RPGs that reads combatant stats from note frontmatter and manages turns, HP, conditions and a combat log.
